Command.Statement: SELECT NON EMPTY Hierarchize({DrilldownLevel({[Store.Store Type].[All Store.Store Types]},,,INCLUDE_CALC_MEMBERS)}) DIMENSION PROPERTIES PARENT_UNIQUE_NAME ON COLUMNS FROM (SELECT Filter([Store.Store Type].[Store Type].AllMembers, ([Store.Store Type].CurrentMember.member_caption="Supermarket")) ON COLUMNS FROM [ZFMSALES]) CELL PROPERTIES VALUE, FORMAT_STRING, LANGUAGE, BACK_COLOR, FORE_COLOR, FONT_FLAGS
